scope: historical source-snapshot replay beside live order CDC; level 3
source: PostgreSQL transactional correction receipt plus external intent/ACK, followed by one repeatable-read export of orders and dimensions
version: order_revision * 1000000 + customer_revision; retain original source values; parent constraints bound both components
input: oldest fifth of 1,000,000 default orders, 10,000 customers; full eight-field Spark/body checks
conflict: Doris Unique Key merge-on-write, native sequence column version, RF3
publication: two independent Stream Load 2PC transactions, durable case-specific labels; crash before second phase; reconcile retained labels
visibility: COMMITTED is not VISIBLE; poll permitted committed state for a 60-second visibility budget, bounded by outer application context
retries: repeat the original commit; native VISIBLE state is required even if HTTP reports an already-completed label error; no new label
expected_fault: publisher SIGKILL exit137 without OOM; parent source ACKs must advance while publisher is down; stream processors and required replicas stay running
recovery: same transaction identities become VISIBLE; all source receipts reconcile and full exact source-to-sink checks pass using each fixed replica without fallback
semantics: replay of a corrected source-of-truth snapshot; not an independently authored historical correction; source acknowledgement counts batches, not individual rows
